author: Jigyashu Saxena
text: Running autonomous coding agents like Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex on full-blast frontier models for every single turn is burning engineering budgets. When an agent needs to read a 10-line file, inspect a git diff, or run a basic regex check, routing that request to a flagship frontier model wastes tokens and adds latency. But naive cost-routers create their own mess: they bust your prompt-cache hits, cause agent loops, and ignore the flat-rate subscriptions your team already pays for. Weave Router 2.0 solves this as a subscription-aware, drop-in proxy designed specifically for agentic developer workflows. https://github.com/weave-os/router

author: Mike Hall
